description: Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to perform an authenticated crawl of a protected website area. 1) Configure 'Forms Based' authentication for 'http://quotes.toscrape.com/login' using username 'admin' and password 'password'. 2) Start a crawl of 'http://quotes.toscrape.com/'. 3) Verify the crawl was authenticated by finding the '/logout/' URL (only visible to logged-in users) in the crawl results. 4) Export the 'Internal > HTML' data to a CSV file in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. 5) Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/auth_success_report.txt' confirming the logout link was found. SUCCESS CRITERIA: The exported CSV must contain the URL 'http://quotes.toscrape.com/logout/'.
